svg.title: gh garden compares the local checkout inventory with GitHub
svg.desc: Diagram showing GitHub repositories, local folders, a read-only comparison, and status categories such as modified, unpushed, behind and not cloned. The report is illustrative.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK KR, Malgun Gothic, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gh garden / what is only on this machine?
